summary: Agent assists customer with unauthorized withdrawal and secures account.

intents.keywords: I am worried my savings account shows of withdrawal...someone stealing my money.

issues.reason(s): Customer did not authorize the transaction.

intents.actions of agent: Confirmed transaction details, froze the account, and filed a fraud report.
intents.Process Request: Fraud report filing and transaction reversal.
intents.resolution: Account secured, transaction reversal initiated within 5-7 days.
